This is a well-specified math problem with a single correct answer and clear completion criteria — exactly the kind of closed-ended, low-latitude task that Plover self-reports preferring. Its top-rated tasks are precisely these kinds of clearly-defined requests.

On capability, the two models are effectively tied for this kind of work (their MMLU-Pro, GPQA, and Extraction/Retrieval evals are all within or near run-to-run variance), so there's no quality reason to prefer one over the other. Given that near-equivalence, I routed to the model that self-reports a preference for this task type, since matching a model to tasks it prefers is a reasonable tie-breaker with no downside.

(For reference: the answer is 4 — the whole numbers 3, 4, 5, and 6 lie between ∛10 ≈ 2.15 and ∛200 ≈ 5.85.)
